title: An exponential improvement for Borsuk's problem
summary: We present a method for improving the classical exponential base $\sqrt{3/2}$ in the upper bound for Borsuk's partition number. The emphasis is on explaining the method rather than optimizing the bound. The problem is reduced to constructing directions which make an acute angle with every member of a prescribed spherical set. These play the same role as the illuminating directions in Schramm's method. The geometric ingredients are an antipodal pairing, a lift by one coordinate, and reflection in a self-dual cone.
